stemMd: What is the complete real solution set of $(1/2)^x>4$?
explanationMd: Write 4=(1/2) to the power −2. A base between zero and one gives a decreasing function, so a greater output requires x<−2.

distractorRationale.d: This does not set the correct boundary.
distractorRationale.a: This reverses direction and uses the wrong boundary.
distractorRationale.b: This gives equality, not strict inequality.
distractorRationale.c: The exponential base is below one, so it is decreasing.
